pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the initial trade has moved at least +$10 in profit and volatility compression confirms a continuation breakout.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-standard-deviation volume spike combined with an order-book imbalance confirmation before executing entry on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$15, trail remaining with a wide ATR-based stop to capture multi-dollar macro runs up to $30+.
